li.label: Learning Algorithms
li.description: With base code built on a self-iterating cognitive architecture, she can learn more from any interaction.\nIn time, she will surely become a remarkable Gray.

li.label: Natural Engineers
li.description: Her base code can construct optimal designs based on a vast built-in library.\nA natural-born builder.

li.label: Natural Physicists
li.description: The systematic knowledge of physical laws stored in her base code helps her conduct research more effectively.\nShe is, so to speak, a natural rationalist.

li.label: Natural Sociologists
li.description: Her base code contains built-in social structure models for various species, allowing her to precisely understand group dynamics and the logic of individual behavior.\nSome people who know her deliberately avoid her, which troubles her a little.

li.label: Perfect And Dainty
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a knack for learning. {PAWN_pronoun} picks things up much faster than others.
